title: openstack-nova-operator-kog values
description: Configuration for the OpenStack Nova KOG (Krateo Operator Generator) chart. Sets the upstream Nova endpoint and toggles which Nova resources are exposed as native Kubernetes custom resources.

restdefinitions.description: Toggle the per-resource RestDefinitions emitted by this chart. Each entry maps a Nova API resource to a generated CRD.

server.description: Nova Servers (compute instances). Generated CRD Kind 'Instance'.

enabled.description: Emit the RestDefinition for Nova servers.

resourceGroup.description: Kubernetes API group for the generated CRD. GVK becomes <resourceGroup>/v1alpha1.

resourceKind.description: Generated CRD Kind. Prefixed (Instance, not Server) to avoid a crdgen Kind-vs-property collision with the envelope-wrapped 'server' payload.

enabled.description: Emit the RestDefinition for Nova flavors.

resourceGroup.description: Kubernetes API group for the generated CRD. GVK becomes <resourceGroup>/v1alpha1.

resourceKind.description: Generated CRD Kind. Prefixed to avoid the crdgen Kind-vs-property collision with the envelope-wrapped 'flavor' payload.

enabled.description: Emit the RestDefinition for Nova keypairs.

resourceGroup.description: Kubernetes API group for the generated CRD. GVK becomes <resourceGroup>/v1alpha1.

resourceKind.description: Generated CRD Kind. Prefixed to avoid the crdgen Kind-vs-property collision with the envelope-wrapped 'keypair' payload.

server_group.description: Nova Server Groups. Generated CRD Kind 'ComputeServerGroup'.

enabled.description: Emit the RestDefinition for Nova server groups.

resourceGroup.description: Kubernetes API group for the generated CRD. GVK becomes <resourceGroup>/v1alpha1.

resourceKind.description: Generated CRD Kind. Prefixed to avoid the crdgen Kind-vs-property collision with the envelope-wrapped 'server_group' payload.

aggregate.description: Nova Host Aggregates. Generated CRD Kind 'ComputeAggregate'.

enabled.description: Emit the RestDefinition for Nova host aggregates.

resourceGroup.description: Kubernetes API group for the generated CRD. GVK becomes <resourceGroup>/v1alpha1.

resourceKind.description: Generated CRD Kind. Prefixed to avoid the crdgen Kind-vs-property collision with the envelope-wrapped 'aggregate' payload.

quota.description: Nova Quota Sets. Generated CRD Kind 'ComputeQuota'. Disabled by default: PUT /os-quota-sets/{tenant_id} needs a KOG path-only mapping.

enabled.description: Emit the RestDefinition for Nova quota sets. Off by default until the path-only mapping lands.

resourceGroup.description: Kubernetes API group for the generated CRD. GVK becomes <resourceGroup>/v1alpha1.

resourceKind.description: Generated CRD Kind. Prefixed to avoid the crdgen Kind-vs-property collision with the envelope-wrapped 'quota_set' payload.

authBridge.description: nova-auth-bridge: a tiny stateless nginx reverse proxy that rewrites the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header (emitted by the Krateo rest-dynamic-controller) into the 'X-Auth-Token: <token>' header that Nova expects. It does no Keystone token exchange.

upstreamUrl.description: THE key user input. Upstream Nova endpoint taken from the Keystone service catalog, e.g. https://compute.gra11.cloud.ovh.net/v2.1/<projectId>. Empty by default; must be set at install time.

image.description: Container image for the auth-bridge proxy.

service.description: Service exposing the auth-bridge proxy in-cluster.

resources.description: Compute resource requests and limits for the auth-bridge container.

podAnnotations.description: Extra annotations to add to the auth-bridge pod.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for scheduling the auth-bridge pod.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for scheduling the auth-bridge pod.

affinity.description: Affinity rules for scheduling the auth-bridge pod.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount to use. If empty and create is false, the default ServiceAccount is used.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified app name used in resource names.
